title: Assessment config
description: A test/quiz config file. 'name' defaults to the config file's stem when omitted.

name.description: Assessment name, used in output filenames.

class_id.description: Optional class identifier; prefixes output filenames when set.

assessment_type.description: Optional filter: keep only questions whose assessment_type matches.

calculator_active.description: Optional filter: true keeps calculator-active questions, false keeps no-calculator questions.

question_count.description: Optional: randomly select exactly this many questions from the filtered pool.

scramble_questions.description: Optional: shuffle the order of selected questions.

dok_target.description: Optional target for the average Depth of Knowledge (1-4).

instructions.description: Raw LaTeX shown in a framed box on the first page.

work_space.description: Default FRQ answer-space height (e.g. '2in'); overridable per question/part.

questions.description: Optional inline questions, in the same format as a question bank.
